purpose: Scroll-linked sticky panel: a fixed visual pins in the viewport while a sequence of feature callouts advance past it. The tallest measured section on the site.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: NOT ACTUALLY IMPLEMENTED in the measured build (corrected Round 3 — see tokens/10-semantic/motion-roles.json's sticky.scrollLinked.reducedMotionCaveat for the verification). The live property-management bundle has no matchMedia/JS reduced-motion check and no CSS override that removes position:sticky under prefers-reduced-motion; the pin persists regardless of the user's motion preference. A generated page using this section should not claim a static-stacked reduced-motion fallback exists today — this is flagged as an open accessibility gap for the component owner, not something to silently invent a value for.

accessibility.note: sticky positioning must not trap scroll or keyboard focus
